title: Sections of a finite étale cover of the punctured power-series open recover its formal sections
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-depth], let $d>0$, and put $B=A[[x_1,\ldots,x_d]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], $f:B\to A$ the constant-coefficient map and $I=\ker(f)$. Let $V\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}(B)$ be open such that the inverse image under $\operatorname{Spec}(f)$ is $\operatorname{Spec}(A)\setminus\{\mathfrak m_A\}$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $P$ be a finite étale cover of $V$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. Put $P_n=P\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(B)}\operatorname{Spec}(B/I^{n+1})$ with projections $p_n:P_n\to P$ and transitions $t_n:P_n\to P_{n+1}$. For every family $s_n\in\Gamma(P_n,\mathcal O_{P_n})$ satisfying $t_n^\sharp(s_{n+1})=s_n$, there is a unique $a\in\Gamma(P,\mathcal O_P)$ with $p_n^\sharp(a)=s_n$ for every $n$.

proof.text: Apply the scalar thickening-family theorem to the compatible family t. It yields a unique power series b with all prescribed restrictions.

The global-sections comparison identifies B with Γ(V,O). Define a=r(b). Any competing a has the form r(c) by its surjectivity. Its restriction equalities make c a second candidate in scalar thickening-family comparison, so c=b and a=r(b). This proves the scalar comparison hypothesis.

Mathlib makes B Noetherian. Apply the general finite étale transfer to f=constantCoeff and V with the scalar comparison just proved, obtaining the unchanged existence-and-uniqueness statement for P and s.

theorem finiteEtale_powerSeries_punctured_cover_sections_comparison
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ x : Spec (.of A),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)))) x ∈ V ↔
        x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    (P : V.toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (s : ∀ n : ℕ, Γ(FiniteEtale.Adic.cover
      (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)) V P n, ⊤))
    (hs : ∀ n, (FiniteEtale.Adic.coverTransition
      (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)) V P n).appTop
        (s (n + 1)) = s n) :
    ∃! a : Γ(P.obj.left, ⊤), ∀ n, (FiniteEtale.Adic.coverMap
      (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)) V P n).appTop a = s n
